_meta.description: Public bodies Deni routes citizens to in South Africa. Each is a real institution with a documented mandate. Verify current contact details at demo/use time.

forums.name: Information Regulator (South Africa)
forums.handles: Misuse of personal information, abusive data-driven collection, POPIA breaches.
forums.channel: Complaint to the Information Regulator (Form 5) via inforegulator.org.za or its online portal.
what_to_include: What personal information was used and how (screenshots of messages)

forums.name: National Credit Regulator (NCR)
forums.handles: Credit-provider registration and conduct, reckless credit, enforcement/repossession under the National Credit Act, unregistered lenders.
what_to_include: The conduct (cost disclosure, reckless credit, enforcement)

forums.name: Credit bureau (TransUnion / Experian / others) via the NCR
forums.channel: Dispute directly with the bureau; if unresolved, escalate to the NCR under its credit-information dispute guidelines.
what_to_include: Why it is wrong (paid / disputed / unregistered lender)

forums.name: Small Claims Court (South Africa)
forums.handles: Civil money claims up to the Small Claims Court limit — refunds, overpayments, small debts. You represent yourself; no lawyer.
forums.channel: Lodge your claim at a Small Claims Court after sending a letter of demand. No advocate is used; a Commissioner hears the matter.
what_to_include: The other party's name and address
The amount claimed and how you calculated it
Proof you sent a letter of demand
